title: Manna in the Wilderness
summary: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time. God fed His people with manna one day at a time. When you want tomorrow solved today, manna teaches kids to receive daily help without hoarding fear.

read_it.prompt: Read Exodus 16:1-18. Watch for what the story shows about provision.

tell_it: Israel was hungry in the wilderness. God gave manna each morning and taught them to gather what they needed. Kids can retell it by naming what happened, who responded, and what God showed.
understand_it: The point is not that manna in the Wilderness is impressive by itself. God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time. When you want tomorrow solved today, manna teaches kids to receive daily help without hoarding fear.
age_5_7_explanation: God fed His people with manna one day at a time.
age_8_11_explanation: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time. The lesson helps older kids compare the story's wise path with the easier path people may have wanted.
teen_explanation: When you want tomorrow solved today, manna teaches kids to receive daily help without hoarding fear. God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time. The story leaves room to talk about courage, humility, repentance, or hope without pretending the hard part is small.
key_truths: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time.
Manna in the Wilderness shows provision through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When you want tomorrow solved today, manna teaches kids to receive daily help without hoarding fear.
life_application: When you want tomorrow solved today, manna teaches kids to receive daily help without hoarding fear.

quiz_questions.question: What food did God give in the wilderness?
quiz_questions.explanation: This answer keeps the focus where the Bible puts it: Manna. God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time.

quiz_questions.question: Name the pressure, problem, or need in Manna in the Wilderness.
quiz_questions.answer: Answers should name the story's real challenge and connect it to God's response.
quiz_questions.explanation: Good retelling notices what was hard before jumping straight to the takeaway.

memory_verse.prompt: Use Exodus 16:15 as the verse anchor for Manna in the Wilderness.

discussion_questions: What surprised you in Manna in the Wilderness?
Why does provision matter in Manna in the Wilderness?
What would change if someone actually lived out the provision lesson in Manna in the Wilderness?

activity.title: Daily Bread Basket
activity.instructions: Draw seven baskets and write one way God provides for each day.

prayer_prompt: Jesus, help me remember the truth in Manna in the Wilderness and live it with people around me.
